capabilities: Display Todoist tasks as boards in a sidebar and in inline todoist-board code blocks
Add, edit, complete, delete, schedule, defer, move, and re-prioritize tasks
Filter task lists with Todoist filter syntax for project, priority, and date queries
Link tasks to Obsidian notes with wikilinks converted to obsidian:// Markdown links in Todoist
Add tasks from the command palette with recurring schedules
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Tokens are migrated to Obsidian Secret Storage on Obsidian 1.11.4+. Mobile use is supported with touch layouts and long-press interactions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or manage tasks that live in a user's Todoist account, so Todoist work has to be done outside the vault.

relations.evidence: displays Todoist tasks as interactive boards in the sidebar or directly inside notes

summary: Task board that displays Todoist tasks as interactive boards in a sidebar and inline code blocks, with two-way sync via the Todoist API.
